definitions.explanation: A street or area lined with shops, often small local businesses, typically with an arcade covering.

examples.japanese: {商店街|しょうてんがい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{散歩|さんぽ}する→散歩する：26840_sanposuru⟧。
examples.english: To stroll through the shopping street.

examples.japanese: ⟦{駅前|えきまえ}→駅前：09593_ekimae⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{商店街|しょうてんがい}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{賑|にぎ}やかだ。
examples.english: The shopping street in front of the station is lively.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧{商店街|しょうてんがい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{昔|むかし}ながら→昔ながら：26817_mukashinagara⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{店|みせ}→店：00497_mise⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{並|なら}んでいる→並ぶ：00605_narabu⟧。
examples.english: This shopping street is lined with old-fashioned shops.

examples.japanese: ⟦{地方|ちほう}→地方：02369_chihou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{商店街|しょうてんがい}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦シャッター{通|どお}り→シャッター通り：29816_shattaadoori⟧になっている⟦{所|ところ}→所：01137_tokoro⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{多|おお}い→多い：01127_ooi⟧。
examples.english: Many shopping streets in rural areas have become deserted with closed shutters.

notes:
{商店街|しょうてんがい} refers to traditional shopping streets found throughout Japan. Many have covered arcades (アーケード) to protect shoppers from weather.

"⟦シャッター{通|どお}り→シャッター通り：29816_shattaadoori⟧" refers to shopping streets where many shops have closed down, a common issue in declining areas.

Related terms:
- ⟦{繁華街|はんかがい}→繁華街：09392_hankagai⟧: downtown, busy commercial district
- ⟦{地下街|ちかがい}→地下街：09390_chikagai⟧: underground shopping area
- アーケード: arcade, covered walkway
